set.body:
Purpose

Close only on evidence from the executed product, not additional constitutional prose.

Acceptance

- Each load-bearing law has a direct law test, exported product-oracle equivalence test, and where statistical, a generative recovery test.
- Fast contract/metamorphic tests run on every change; reference Monte Carlo tests and 50-60k stress gates run on declared slower tiers.
- Validation status is reported separately as algebraically established, numerically verified, statistically validated, and scale-qualified.
- Print/format/coercion methods and runnable Rd examples cover the first user journey.
- README begins with the fMRI problem solved and names current limitations.
- Installed-package tests, vignettes, and R CMD check pass under the declared environment.
- The final report lists surviving public exports, physical lowerings, statistical estimands, scale regimes, and all unrun external/hosted evidence.
- No new broad theory/specification document is added.
set.title: Epic 9: Rebalance evidence and close the statistical 0.1 gate
